units.source_text: 盥洗用具和早膳都送到这里来。

en.t: Washing utensils and breakfast were both brought here.

units.source_text: 源氏公子起身时太阳已经很高。

en.t: By the time Prince Genji rose, the sun was already high.

units.source_text: 他吩咐道：“这里没有侍女，很不方便。

en.t: He gave orders, saying, "There are no serving women here, which is very inconvenient.

units.source_text: 今天晚上选几个适当的人来此伺候。”

en.t: Choose a few suitable people to come and attend here tonight."

units.source_text: 又命令到东殿去唤几个女童来和紫儿做伴：“只拣年纪小的到这里来！”

en.t: He also ordered someone to go to the eastern wing and summon several young girls to keep Zier company: "Bring only the little ones here!"

units.source_text: 立刻来了四个非常可爱的女孩。

en.t: Four very charming girls came at once.
